name: q-anacleto-y-q-boby
description: Q-Anacleto y Q-Boby — Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 (EdTech)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && (uv sync --directory backend || echo "Aviso: backend/ o uv aun no disponible; puedes usar npm run dev:mock")
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && (uv run --directory backend pytest || echo "Aviso: pytest backend aun no disponible")
